svg.title: Sequence - triage a failed pipeline
svg.text: Sequence: from a failed pipeline to an evidence-backed MR note
Main flow (UC-17.1). Solid = request, dashed = response. The LLM provider is whichever one is enabled in llm-providers.yaml.
loop: until evidence is sufficient or a budget is hit
9. gitlab: failed jobs, traces, MR diff, job history
C · Reason: observe → reason → act (max 12 steps, token and time budget)
21. Policy Guard: tool on the allow-list?
Output schema: root_cause, confidence (high / medium / low),
29. validate: each claim cites a tool_call
Invalid citations or low confidence ⇒ publish 'needs human triage'
35. reads note; decides on the fix
The engineer applies the fix. The agent never pushes code, edits CI variables,
changes runners, or retries production jobs (autonomy ceiling = comment).
